response.rationale: A ('Pending Booking') is defined in BookingRepository (node 2e3c5728fffb0180, src/persistence/bookingRepository.ts) as a status-filtered subset of bookings: `return [...this.bookings.values()].filter((b) => b.status === "pending");`. B ('Booking') is the general booking entity created in BookingService (node 3aa201f0edaa9fd6, src/business/bookingService.ts): `const booking = this.bookings.create({`. A pending booking is one lifecycle state of the same Booking record, a narrower specialisation rather than another name for Booking itself. They are closely related (BookingService calls BookingRepository.findPending), but the subset is not the same concept as the whole.
